newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The Constitutional Court validated results of first round of presidential elections on November 3, with incumbent Ion Iliescu and Democratic Convention's (CDR) Emil Constantinescu heading for second-round run-offs on November 17.
* A court statement said irregularities in Sunday's vote did not influence the validity of the elections.
* The leading boards of both parliament chambers are expected to set the air time for the two presidential candidates ahead of November 17 second-round run-offs.

* The interests of the masses of people will be neglected if a president is elected from the opposition blocs that won parliament elections, Iliescu said during campaign in Braila and Galati counties.
* He said he was willing to support the current parliament majority provided that it keeps its promises of reform.
* Iliescu held a news conference at the Galati steel mill.

* The future government formed by the CDR and Social Democratic Union (USD) will be able to apply the reforms it is committed to if the country's president supports the cabinet, Constantinescu told a news conference on Friday.
He said the former ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) was playing its last chance to block reforms, by imposing Iliescu to presidency.
Constantinescu vowed Romanians won't face a harsh winter and said there won't be political purges when his coalition takes over.

* The CDR-USD government coalition is fragile and politically unstable, with the Hungarian Democratic Union, an ethnic group, holding the key to parliament majority, PDSR executive president Adrian Nastase told a news conference.
* Nastase slammed the National Peasant Party -- CDR's backbone -- for allegedly trying to involve the Romanian Orthodox Church in the campaign ahead of presidential run-offs.

* Reform Minister Mircea Cosea represents Romania at the summit of the Central European Initiative (CEI) in Austria. Cosea will discuss reforms and strategies to boost Romania's chances of integration into the European Union. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
